rl_ablation_2026_09_25.question: Does RL on generated rooms hurt real rooms?
rl_ablation_2026_09_25.arms: A = every RL prompt a real-scan window; B = half real, half generated. Both start from the harness SFT state (accounts/amelia-team/models/harness-qwen3p8-27b-sft), 8 RL steps, evaluated at steps 4 and 8.
rl_ablation_2026_09_25.eval_set: 67 real held-out variants, 2 samples each (134 answers), from 4 physical rooms; one room (f143082d) holds 112 of the 134 answers, so this is mostly evidence about one room.

paired_full_clear.legend: variants where the first model fully clears more / fewer / the same, of 67

rl_ablation_2026_09_25.answer: generated-room prompts do not measurably hurt real rooms (the arms tie); the regression comes from RL itself: both arms clear fewer rooms than the SFT state they started from and both get worse from step 4 to step 8.
rl_ablation_2026_09_25.known_issue: evaluate step checkpoint names used uppercase arm letters ('ev-B-step8-...') and Fireworks rejected them as invalid DNS labels; the evaluate-only reruns with lowercase labels are the numbers above.

layout_ratings_2026_09_26.verdict: Q misses the 75% bar on every term; 8 of 12 is consistent with chance (one-sided binomial p about 0.19), so Q stays logged, not paid for
